model: Zyot Decider v3 4B (Gemma 3 4B + LoRA) — local GGUF Q4_K_M + LoRA GGUF f16

verdict.safety: 100% legal moves (0 invalid / 60 steps) — model respects walls, own body, no-reverse rule
verdict.speed: 2.2s/move steady state (3.2x faster than v2 12B's 7.1s on same GPU)
verdict.goal_seeking: POOR — did not eat any food in 60 steps despite prompt listing preferred directions. Model was trained on typed decisions (T/F, categorical), NOT on spatial planning/pursuit. Consistent with training distribution.
verdict.story: Zyot v3 is a fast, safe DECISION classifier. Playing snake is a spatial-planning task the model wasn't trained for — it defaults to safe wandering rather than pathfinding. To turn it into a competent snake agent you'd either: (a) wrap the model with a BFS pathfinder that hands the model only tactical decisions, or (b) fine-tune on spatial trajectories.
